descriptive_supplement.scope: Descriptive post-run extraction, not causal ablation. State-conditioned costs use different solution sets. Counters describe recorded rows, not optimal MILP counts; null is not zero.

audit.scope: 100 shared clean-correct inputs, 3 fixed same-family models; observed bounded costs, not uncensored speedup. Structural audits are not independent SAFE proofs. Degenerate bootstrap intervals are not equivalence evidence.

independent_review.scope: Frozen structural auditor plus full-model UNSAFE replay; not independent reproof of SAFE
